verdict.rationale: Gitleaks' core `git` command scans full git history via `git log -p`, and a hands-on probe confirmed it detects secrets present only in earlier commits, exiting non-zero for CI gating. This is corroborated by both docs and independent probe evidence, covering the exact story of scanning a repo's full history for hardcoded secrets. Missing for 10: no evidence of scale/performance on large real-world repos or edge-case coverage beyond the small fixture test.
